dataset: GPCC Global Precipitation Climatology (1991-2020) version 2025, 0.25 degree

network.TLS: curl default certificate and hostname verification enabled; no insecure flags, trust-store changes, pinned-key exceptions, redirect following, proxy bypass or alternate storage

coordinateSystem: geographic longitude/latitude on regular 0.25-degree grid; source does not explicitly declare a geodetic datum

latitudeUnitAnomaly.used: north-positive values in the actual lat array, descending from 89.875 to -89.875; no data flip
evidence: current repository exact-product Europe/West Asia processing
official legacy GPCC format description has first row at positive northern latitude
four Mexico control cells have 12 valid values; their sign-flipped Pacific counterparts are all missing

priorEvidence.note: DataCite confirms the exact publisher and product URL but supplies no registered rights. The license evidence is the official DWD indexed legal-notice text linked by the product page, not a DataCite rights claim. No access bypass used.

licenseEvidence.currentVerification: Same exact archive SHA and product-page link verified. DWD README on allowed host confirms free access. No www.dwd.de request was made in this run; complete legal notice was not re-fetched.

citation: Rustemeier, Elke; Finger, Peter; Schirmeister, Zora; Ziese, Markus (2025): GPCC Precipitation Analysis Climatology Version 2025 at 0.25°. DOI: 10.5676/DWD_GPCC/CLIMAT_V2025_025. GPCC/DWD, CC BY 4.0.
modifications: Extract Mexico rectangle; sum 12 complete monthly normals; retain every cell with positive land intersection; clip at original polygon pixel centres; color by continuous blue mm/year legend. No gap fill, spatial smoothing or station-to-grid equality claimed.
originalMethod: Rain-gauge monthly climatological interpolation. The fixed-period product requires at least 20 complete years, per product description; this is not a requirement of 30 complete observed years at every station.
